name: "biz-4p-7p"
description: "Apply the Marketing Mix (4P/7P) framework to design tactical marketing decisions across Product, Price, Place, Promotion — plus People, Process, Physical Evidence for services. Use this skill when the user needs to plan a product launch, design a go-to-market strategy, or audit their marketing mix — even if they say 'how should we price this', 'where should we sell', or 'what's our go-to-market plan'.".
